stemMd: Why take cores from more stable parts of the second lake?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They guarantee an ash layer will be found.

options.label: B
options.textMd: They may preserve material lost from the disturbed location.

options.label: C
options.textMd: They necessarily contain more recent eruptions.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They avoid the need to compare layers.

options.label: E
options.textMd: They establish the volcano's exact height.

explanationMd: If slumping removed part of one sequence, an undisturbed location may retain it. The comparison tests record loss without assuming in advance that ash reached the lake.

distractorRationale.a: The proposal remains testable and uncertain.
distractorRationale.c: Stability does not determine eruption frequency.
